title: Ceramic Tabletop Fountain for Indoor and Outdoor Table Desk Office Patio (Ceramic Fountain)

videos.creator: Seller
videos.description: • A product overview video that showcases a black ceramic tabletop water fountain, highlighting its two-tier design with a rectangular upper tray, decorative river stones, and a sculpted spout that circulates water continuously into the rounded lower basin. • Water flow is shown from multiple angles, including close-up shots of the spout pouring into the upper tray and water cascading in thin streams over the tray's edge into the bowl below, demonstrating the fountain's quiet, recirculating operation.

videos.description: • A product overview video that shows a ceramic tabletop fountain in operation, with water flowing from a spout on an upper tray and cascading down into a rounded dark ceramic bowl below. • The upper tray features decorative polished stones and a sculpted spout element, while the dark matte ceramic bowl sits on a wooden surface, giving the fountain a zen, minimalist aesthetic suited for indoor desk or table use.
